preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 2 <= n <= 200000 for n in test_case_ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 2 and 2*10^5 inclusive.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(p, int) and 1 <= p <= n and isinstance(a, int) and 1 <= a <= 10**9 and isinstance(b, int) and 1 <= b <= 10**9 for p, a, b in all_edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge description contains valid integers p, a, b within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(all_edges) == sum(n - 1 for n in test_case_ns)
preconditions.description: The total number of edge descriptions matches the sum of (n-1) for all test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= n for p, a, b in all_edges)
preconditions.description: The parent p for each edge is a valid vertex index within the current test case.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n - 1 for line, n in zip(output_lines, test_case_ns))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly n-1 integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= r <= len(path_edges) for r in results) for results in all_results)
postconditions.description: Each result r_i is a non-negative integer not exceeding the length of the path from root to i.

postconditions.expression: all(all(sum(b_prefix) <= A_i and (len(b_prefix) == len(path_edges) or sum(b_prefix + [next_b]) > A_i) for r, path_edges, A_i, b_prefix, next_b in zip(results, paths, A_values, b_prefixes, next_b_values)) for results, paths, A_values, b_prefixes, next_b_values in zip(all_results, all_paths, all_A, all_b_prefixes, all_next_b))
postconditions.description: For each vertex i, r_i is the maximum length of a prefix of the path from root to i such that the sum of b values in that prefix does not exceed A_i (the sum of a values on the full path).
